format_note:
## Case format
```json
{ "case_id": "PUB-01", "today": "2026-04-14", "months": {"last": "2026-03", "this": "2026-04"},
  "salary_bdt": "30000.00",
  "expenses": [ {"id": "E001", "date": "2026-03-01", "category": "Rent", "shop": "Landlord", "amount_bdt": "10000.00"}, ... ],
  "pockets": [ {"id": "SP-1", "name": "Bike", "item": "Honda Livo", "target_bdt": "76000.00", "monthly_contribution_bdt": "15000.00"} ],
  "dps_annual_rate_percent": "9.00",
  "dps_rule": "Annual rate as stated. Each month: balance = balance + deposit, then interest = balance x rate / 12 / 100 rounded half up to the paisa and added to the balance ..." }
```
`today` is inside `months.this`; no expense is dated after it. Public cases carry 2 months of 41 to 61
1 pocket.

cases.dps_rule: Annual rate as stated. Each month: balance = balance + deposit, then interest = balance x rate / 12 / 100 rounded half up to the paisa and added to the balance (interest joins the balance, so later months earn on it).
